course.title: Hair Braiding
course.tagline: Braid neat, lasting styles: cornrows, knotless braids and twists, from parting to finish.

days.title: Welcome to Braiding
days.goal: By the end of today you can explain and practise: Your kit is a rat-tail comb, clips, braiding hair, gel, spray bottle and a mannequin head.

video.title: How to Do Knotless Braids at Home: Step-by-Step Tutorial

steps: Get your tools ready: rat-tail comb, braiding hair and edge control.
Watch the video. It explains the main point in simple steps: A rat-tail comb is the key tool for clean, straight partings.
Your kit is a rat-tail comb, clips, braiding hair, gel, spray bottle and a practice head. Go slowly. Practise on a model or a practice head.
Do the same move three times. Check your work in a mirror or a photo after each try.
Write down what went well, what was hard, and one thing to do better tomorrow.
days.task: Practise welcome to braiding on a model or a practice head. Your kit is a rat-tail comb, clips, braiding hair, gel, spray bottle and a practice head. Take a photo of your work.
days.challenge: Do welcome to braiding two times today. Make the second try neater than the first.

quiz.q: Which of these is true about braiding?
options: A rat-tail comb is used only to dry hair.
A rat-tail comb is the key tool for clean, straight partings.
Clean partings need no comb at all.
A rat-tail comb makes partings messy and crooked.
quiz.explain: A rat-tail comb is the key tool for clean, straight partings.

quiz.q: What do you use to make clean, straight partings?
options: braiding hair
edge control
rat-tail comb
spray bottle
quiz.explain: A rat-tail comb makes clean, straight partings.

quiz.q: What should you always do when braiding hair?
options: braid the edges as tightly as you can
start braiding without checking the scalp
let the hair dry out while you braid
never braid too tightly at the edges
quiz.explain: Never braid too tightly at the edges.

days.title: Hair Prep for Braids
days.goal: By the end of today you can explain and practise: Wash, deep condition, detangle and blow-dry the hair before any braiding starts.

video.title: Knotless Braids Tutorial for Beginners

steps: Get your tools ready: rat-tail comb, braiding hair and edge control.
Watch the video. It explains the main point in simple steps: Braids last longer when the hair is clean and detangled first.
Wash, deep condition, detangle and blow-dry the hair before any braiding starts. Go slowly. Practise on a model or a practice head.
Do the same move three times. Check your work in a mirror or a photo after each try.
Write down what went well, what was hard, and one thing to do better tomorrow.

quiz.q: Which of these is true about hair prep for braids?
options: Braids last longer on dirty, tangled hair.

quiz.q: What do you add to make braids longer and fuller?
options: edge control
spray bottle
rat-tail comb
braiding hair
